flutter_integration.note: Use the onnxruntime Flutter package, not tflite_flutter. RF-DETR uses transformer attention ops not fully supported in TFLite.

preprocessing.resize: letterbox to model input resolution (preserve aspect ratio, pad with gray 128)

decoding.note: RF-DETR is NMS-free — no NMS code needed in Flutter
decoding.dets_output: normalized cxcywh bounding boxes — apply sigmoid, convert to xyxy, scale to image size
decoding.labels_output: class logits (num_classes + 1 columns — last column is no-object, drop it). Apply sigmoid per class (multi-label, not softmax). CRITICAL: match outputs by NAME ('dets'/'labels'), not by position or shape.
